newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Boston raises Intel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Boston raises Intel.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Jack Gerrity said he raised his earnings estimates for the 1997 and 1998 years and boosted his 6-month target price to $200 from $175 previously.
-- The analyst analyst said he expected the company to earn $9 in 1997, up from his prior $8.21 per share view.
-- He said he expected the company to report earnings of $10.82 per share in 1998 versus his prior $9.25 per share view.
-- The $200 price target is based on the price of the shares before a two-for-one stock split becomes effective.

-- Referring to the company's fourth quarter earnings report released late Tuesday, in which the company more than doubled its profits year-to-year, Gerrity said that, "Somebody said -- I guess it was the company -- that they hit on all eight cylinders.
"If they had a 12-cylinder car they would have hit on all 12-cylinders," he said.
